text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — planning a minor release tomorrow 11:00 PT (v0.9.7). Need final release notes, internal announce copy, and ops pin for the serving runtime and model. Canary plan below.

Jonah Kim: 11:00 PT works for eng. I'll own runtime pin + deploy job. Which image tag should we freeze?

Maya Patel: Freeze runtime to rdx-runtime:2026-03-19 and model-serving v1.2.3. Please add a short note in RN about the quantization tweak.

Priya Rao: Canary lanes: 10% traffic -> 30m, scale to 5 nodes. Rollback criteria: >1% 5xx across canary or p50 latency +200ms vs baseline. I'll create the alert and a dashboard snippet.

Carlos Vega: I'll draft the internal announce. Keep it short: 3 bullets (what, when, impact) and ops contact. Leave a link to the revert playbook.

Maya Patel: Draft internal announce — please eyeball: ```Heads up: v0.9.7 rolling 11:00 PT tomorrow. Includes quantization perf fix for model-serving (v1.2.3). Expected impact: lower token cost for short sequences. Ops standby: 11:00-12:30 PT. If you see user-facing errors, tag #incidents and ping @oncall.```

Jonah Kim: Looks good. Add note: "Canary will only route to Dedicated clusters in us-west-2". Also I'll pin the image tag and open a tiny PR to prevent accidental rebuilds.

Priya Rao: Added rollback command to RN: ```rdxctl rollout revert --service model-serving --to-tag rdx-runtime:2026-03-15``` — tested in staging.

Carlos Vega: Internal blurb ready. Short variant for slack: "Deploying v0.9.7 11:00 PT — perf and cost fixes for model-serving. Ops standby 11:00-12:30 PT. Questions? ping @Carlos or @Priya." Long variant sent to mailing list with tech details and links.

Jonah Kim: @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary for 1769997600 (11:00 PT tomorrow) and add the canary tag?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1769997600. Canary ID cid-2026-03-20-11. Config: 10% traffic, duration 1800s, nodes=5, region=us-west-2.

Priya Rao: I'll watch the canary and have the rollback runbook open. If the latency alert fires, I'll start rollback and DM the list.

Maya Patel: Great — final ask: ops pin in console (no auto-updates) + attach RN link. Can we get that before EOD? :thumbsup:

Jonah Kim: Will pin before EOD and drop RN link here.

oncall-bot: Reminder to oncall: standby window 1769997600-1769999400.

deploy-bot: (follow-up) When canary hits, will post start/complete events here.
